findings.text: Empty directory initializer establishes a two link directory owned by root with cleared device size and block count and page sized block granularity and attaches empty directory inode and file operation vectors while clearing extended attribute support.

Visibility control toggles hidden state for non directory nodes under exclusive root guard and either clears hidden and activates when already marked activated or sets hidden and applies deactivation bias and drains current users.

Self removal plus named removal plus namespace aware rename provide the external mutation interface for the hierarchy with boolean success for self removal and status codes for named removal and rename.
Active protection break and unbreak helpers release and temporarily restore the active reference with dependency tracking so a caller can step outside the dependency chain during removal.
Descriptor lock reporter walks flock plus posix plus lease sets for an inode and emits only entries tied to the given open file and owner.

Refresh from node to inode copies mode unconditionally and copies persistent ownership and three timestamps only when a non default attribute record exists and recomputes directory link count from sub directory count plus two unless removal is in progress.

Default attribute initialization sets mode and timestamp state while explicit attribute application copies user and group identity and access plus modification plus change times from the persistent record.

Directory emission advances a small position counter through dot and dot dot before hashed entries and masks emitted type with file type mask combined with caller supplied mask while dot entries report directory type with current and parent inode numbers.
Revision stamping copies the parent directory revision into the time field of a dentry.

Cached directory position is accepted only when the candidate remains active and still parented as expected and hash matches, otherwise a tree search by hash and namespace identifier locates the restart point and both paths skip entries that are inactive or in another namespace.

Proc descriptor display resolves task from inode pid then looks up the descriptor under task and file table guards and reports position plus flags with close on exec folded in plus mount identifier plus inode number before delegating to lock display and optional driver hook.
Proc namespace and info helpers derive namespace from superblock private info and derive descriptor number plus task plus pid through enclosing record conversion from inode.
Open file accessor retrieves the open record from sequence private state and operation accessor returns attribute operations after asserting held state when dependency tracking is enabled.
Single entry sequence start yields a start token only at offset zero and next step for plain files simply advances offset and terminates.

Visibility toggle and rename hold the root hierarchy guard exclusively while self removal and named removal nest a shared supers guard outside the exclusive hierarchy guard and rename additionally serializes parent changes with an interrupt disabling rename guard.
Directory listing holds the hierarchy guard shared across the whole walk and pins the current node with a reference while release drops that reference.
Sequence start nests per open file mutex outside the active reference and stop releases the active reference before dropping the mutex, ensuring operations for one open file do not run concurrently.

Descriptor display nests task guard outside file table spin guard and lock display holds inode lock context spin guard while iterating three lock sets, with a dedicated global spin guard protecting the notify list.
Unbreak path temporarily bumps the active counter and performs dependency acquisition when tracking is enabled, with the bump undone by the enclosing operation and unable to break deactivation.

Open node record contains a reclamation head plus an atomic event counter plus a wait queue for polling plus a list head linking open files plus two unsigned counters for mapped users and pending releases.
Notify state consists of a global spin guard plus a global node pointer initialized to a distinctive end marker value derived from its own address.

Self removal arbitration lets only the first caller mark suicidal and perform removal then mark suicided, while losers sleep and recheck under dropped and reacquired guards until suicided plus fully deactivated bias is observed, with active restoration done while still exclusive to avoid premature wakeup.

Sequence handling acquires active state under mutex then dispatches to custom start or next or stop hooks when present and falls back to single entry behavior otherwise, with a device gone sentinel causing immediate active release and with show sampling the open generation event.

Directory iteration emits dots first then walks hashed siblings in order updating file position to current hash and pinning each entry, aborting when the consumer stops accepting and otherwise clearing the saved position and parking at the maximum value at end.

Show and hide transitions clear or set the hidden flag and respectively activate when already marked activated or add deactivation bias and drain, all under exclusive guard and rejected for directories.

Directory inode vectors expose lookup plus permission plus attribute get and set plus extended attribute listing plus mkdir plus rmdir plus rename, where the three mutating handlers validate operation presence and active state and delegate by name.

Directory file vectors expose generic directory read plus shared iteration plus release plus generic seek, with shared iteration bound to the hashed readdir walker and release bound to reference drop.
Sequence vectors bind start plus next plus stop plus show to active aware wrappers that enforce single opener serialization and active lifetime around custom attribute operations.
Proc descriptor info and lock status formatters serve as sequence show handlers that render ownership and location plus per lock detail lines for flock and posix and lease families.

Mutation handlers fail with permission when operation tables are absent and with device absence when nodes are inactive, rename additionally rejects any flags and rejects root moves and collisions and invariant parent moves and empty directory targets and allocation failure.
Callers trigger single shot warnings for hiding a directory and for removing with a null parent and for invariant parent mismatch and for a non empty tree link after failed self removal arbitration.

Lock reporting translates owner identity into the viewer namespace and shows zero when the owner is gone or not visible and distinguishes access versus open file description versus plain posix plus flock plus lease versus delegation plus breaking versus active versus breaker states with device and inode or none placeholder and range or end extent.

Open file active acquisition returns null when the file was already released or the node is inactive, and sequence dispatch treats device gone from custom start or next as a signal to unwind active state immediately.

Empty directory default uses directory file type with read and execute for all users, root user and group ownership, cleared device and size and block count, page shift block bits, and empty directory operation vectors with extended attribute support cleared.

Directory positions zero and one select dot and dot dot with progression to two for first real entry and maximum signed integer marks end of stream, while notify list termination uses the address of the list head itself as sentinel.
